parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html

订阅实例ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
参数DtsInstanceId与DtsJobId，两者必须传入其一

parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The parent task ChannelId of the distributed task
parameters.name: parent_channel_id

ConsumerGroupName.description_en: The name of the consumer group

ConsumerGroupUserName.description_en: The account of the consumer group

ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_en: The consumption checkpoint, which is the point in time when the client consumed the last message in the subscription channel. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_zh: 消费位点，即客户端在订阅通道内消费最后一条信息的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

MessageDelay.description_en:
The message delay. This value is calculated as the timestamp of the latest data consumed by the downstream client minus the timestamp of the latest data in the change tracking task. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
For example, if the latest data in the source database was generated at 10:00, the DTS change tracking task has read data up to 09:55, and the downstream client has consumed data up to 09:30, the message delay is the difference in UNIX timestamps between 09:55 and 09:30.

If this parameter returns -1, no client is connected to the consumer group
MessageDelay.description_zh:
消息延迟时间，该时间=下游客户端最新消费数据的时间戳-数据订阅任务中最新订阅数据的时间戳，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒。
例如，源库最新的数据于10点产生，目前DTS订阅任务已读取到源库9点55分的数据，下游客户端消费到9点30分的数据，此时消息延迟时间应为9点55分至9点30分的unix时间戳差值。

如果该参数返回-1，则表示当前没有客户端连接该消费组

UnconsumedData.description_en:
The total number of unconsumed messages, which is the sum of unconsumed subscription data and heartbeat messages.
If this parameter returns -1, no client is connected to the consumer group
UnconsumedData.description_zh:
未消费的消息总数，为未消费的订阅数据数量与心跳消息数量的和。
如果该参数返回-1，则表示当前没有客户端连接该消费组

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用出错时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

PageRecordCount.description_en: The maximum number of consumer groups that can be displayed on one page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 一页最多可展示的消费组数量

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of consumer groups
